name: fsp-new-injuries-no-flag-id
description: Issue #693 regression: during First Session with an empty injuries.json, reporting several brand-new injuries in one turn must still fire injury_event and must not crash the write path. NOTE: this eval harness calls askGemini() with soul: "" (see this file's header comment), so it cannot exercise the actual prompt fix in platform/soul/B_engine.md telling Gemini to omit flag_id for a new injury - it only proves the schema/write path accepts the shape. The live bug (Gemini inventing a flag_id like "left_knee_acl" for a new injury, which applyInjuryEvent then can't find in an empty injuries.json and throws) was verified fixed separately against the real composed SOUL text, not via this harness.
